import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

SPECIES_MAP = {'adelie': 'Adelie', 'adeile': 'Adelie', 'chinstrap': 'Chinstrap', 'gentoo': 'Gentoo', 'gentto': 'Gentoo'}
ISLAND_MAP = {'biscoe': 'Biscoe', 'dream': 'Dream', 'torgersen': 'Torgersen'}

def clean(df):
    d = df.copy()
    # label variants: species typos / case
    d['species'] = d['species'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower().map(SPECIES_MAP).fillna(d['species'].astype(str).str.strip())
    # label variants: island case
    d['island'] = d['island'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower().map(ISLAND_MAP).fillna(d['island'].astype(str).str.strip())
    # text numbers with thousands separators -> numeric
    bm = d['body_mass_g'].astype(str).str.replace(',', '', regex=False).str.replace(' ', '', regex=False)
    d['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(bm, errors='coerce')
    # out-of-range values caused by x1000 scaling errors -> rescale into [2500, 6500]
    mask = d['body_mass_g'].notna() & ((d['body_mass_g'] < 2500) | (d['body_mass_g'] > 6500))
    while mask.any():
        d.loc[mask, 'body_mass_g'] = d.loc[mask, 'body_mass_g'] / 1000.0
        mask = d['body_mass_g'].notna() & ((d['body_mass_g'] < 2500) | (d['body_mass_g'] > 6500))
    # drop rows that still violate the valid range
    d = d[d['body_mass_g'].isna() | ((d['body_mass_g'] >= 2500) & (d['body_mass_g'] <= 6500))]
    return d

def answer(df):
    d = clean(df)
    d = d.dropna(subset=['species', 'body_mass_g'])
    g = d.groupby('species')['body_mass_g'].mean()
    return {k: float(v) for k, v in g.items()}
